body.purpose: 17px root — the whole rem grid runs ~6% larger than a 16px default. Elderly-first floor.

money-display.purpose: PriceTag xl and totals. Always lining-nums tabular-nums via [data-money].

label.purpose: Labels and buttons are semibold at full body size; never small caps, never tiny.

shadows.name: shadow-card
shadows.purpose: Resting cards and white panels. Ink-tinted, never neutral black.

shadows.name: shadow-raised
shadows.purpose: Sheets, dialogs, the docked Cobrar strip — anything floating over content.

motion.name: press-scale
motion.purpose: Every button confirms the tap physically.

motion.name: sheet-enter
motion.purpose: Mobile bottom sheets; desktop dialogs zoom-in-95 instead.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one obvious action per screen: money-green fill, 48px tall, visible Spanish label.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 0.5rem; height: 48px; padding: 0 1.25rem; background: var(--primary, #0f7b4d); color: #ffffff; font-family: 'Atkinson Hyperlegible Next Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 17px; font-weight: 600; border: none; border-radius: 12px; cursor: pointer; transition: all 0.15s; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: var(--primary-hover, #0c6a42); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: scale(0.98); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgb(15 123 77 / 0.4); }

components.name: Outline Button
components.description: Secondary action: white with a strong hairline, same 48px stature.
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; height: 48px; padding: 0 1.25rem; background: #ffffff; color: var(--foreground, #182420); font-family: 'Atkinson Hyperlegible Next Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 17px; font-weight: 600; border: 1px solid var(--border-strong, #cfd6d3); border-radius: 12px; cursor: pointer; transition: all 0.15s; } .ds-btn-outline:hover { background: var(--secondary, #eef1f0); } .ds-btn-outline:active { transform: scale(0.98); } .ds-btn-outline:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgb(15 123 77 / 0.4); }

components.name: Soft Button
components.description: Green presence without green weight: soft-green fill for supporting confirmed actions.
components.css: .ds-btn-soft { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; height: 48px; padding: 0 1.25rem; background: var(--primary-soft, #e3f3ea); color: var(--primary-soft-foreground, #0a5c39); font-family: 'Atkinson Hyperlegible Next Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 17px; font-weight: 600; border: none; border-radius: 12px; cursor: pointer; transition: all 0.15s; } .ds-btn-soft:hover { background: rgb(227 243 234 / 0.7); } .ds-btn-soft:active { transform: scale(0.98); } .ds-btn-soft:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgb(15 123 77 / 0.4); }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: 48px white field, hairline stroke; focus turns the border green with a soft ring; caret is green.
components.css: .ds-input { display: flex; width: 100%; height: 48px; padding: 0.25rem 0.875rem; background: var(--input-background, #ffffff); color: var(--foreground, #182420); font-family: 'Atkinson Hyperlegible Next Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 17px; border: 1px solid var(--input, #cfd6d3); border-radius: 12px; caret-color: var(--primary, #0f7b4d); transition: color 0.15s, box-shadow 0.15s; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: var(--muted-foreground, #55625c); } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: none; border-color: var(--ring, #0f7b4d); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgb(15 123 77 / 0.3); }

components.name: Stock Chip
components.description: Stock level as words a first-day employee reads correctly: green OK, amber low, red out.
components.html: 24 u Quedan 4 u Agotado
components.css: .ds-chip { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; padding: 0.25rem 0.625rem; border-radius: 9999px; font-family: 'Atkinson Hyperlegible Next Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 600; white-space: nowrap; font-variant-numeric: lining-nums tabular-nums; } .ds-chip-ok { background: var(--primary-soft, #e3f3ea); color: var(--primary-soft-foreground, #0a5c39); } .ds-chip-low { background: var(--pending-soft, #fdf2e0); color: var(--pending, #8a5a06); } .ds-chip-out { background: var(--destructive-soft, #fceceb); color: var(--destructive-soft-foreground, #9c2323); }

components.name: PriceTag
components.description: The one way to print a current price: dollars and bolívares at equal weight; reference-lens Bs goes amber with a 'ref.' suffix. Historical rows never use this — they print stored snapshots.
components.css: .ds-pricetag { display: inline-flex; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: baseline; column-gap: 0.5rem; color: var(--foreground, #182420); font-family: 'Atkinson Hyperlegible Next Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 1.75rem; line-height: 1.2; font-weight: 700; font-variant-numeric: lining-nums tabular-nums; } .ds-pricetag-dot { font-weight: 400; color: var(--border-strong, #cfd6d3); }

components.name: Card
components.description: White panel on cool paper: hairline border plus ink-tinted soft shadow, always both.
components.html:
Resumen del día

12 ventas registradas
components.css: .ds-card { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 0.5rem; padding: 1.5rem; background: var(--card, #ffffff); color: var(--card-foreground, #182420); border: 1px solid var(--border, #e3e8e6); border-radius: 12px; box-shadow: var(--shadow-card, 0 1px 2px rgb(24 36 32 / 0.05), 0 4px 12px rgb(24 36 32 / 0.05)); font-family: 'Atkinson Hyperlegible Next Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-card-title { margin: 0; font-size: 17px; font-weight: 600; line-height: 1.45; } .ds-card-body { margin: 0; font-size: 17px; color: var(--muted-foreground, #55625c); }

components.name: Bottom Tab Bar
components.description: Mobile shell: five equal tabs, icon plus always-visible Spanish label, soft-green active state.
components.css: .ds-tabbar { display: flex; gap: 0.25rem; padding: 0.375rem 0.75rem; background: #ffffff; border-top: 1px solid var(--border, #e3e8e6); } .ds-tab { position: relative; display: flex; flex: 1; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 0.25rem; height: 60px; background: transparent; border: none; border-radius: 12px; color: var(--muted-foreground, #55625c); font-family: 'Atkinson Hyperlegible Next Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; transition: color 0.15s, background 0.15s; } .ds-tab:hover { background: var(--secondary, #eef1f0); } .ds-tab:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgb(15 123 77 / 0.4); } .ds-tab-active { background: var(--primary-soft, #e3f3ea); color: var(--primary-soft-foreground, #0a5c39); }

narrative.overview: A point-of-sale for Venezuelan shops that the slowest user at the counter operates unaided. The world is one calm light room: a cool paper ground, white cards, near-black green-tinted ink, and exactly one hue that means anything — a deep money green for confirmed actions and confirmed money. Two auxiliary signals exist and are never decorative: amber means 'pending / not yet real' (offline outbox, reference-lens figures), red means destructive or out-of-stock. Everything else is grayscale-on-paper. The system deliberately refuses the dense admin-dashboard default: one obvious action per screen, oversized controls, money printed large in both currencies at equal weight. Legibility is the material: the entire UI is set in Atkinson Hyperlegible Next (self-hosted), the base size is 17px, and every comparable number is tabular.
keyCharacteristics: One accent (money green); amber and red are state signals, never styling.
Cool paper canvas behind white, hairline-bordered, soft-shadowed cards.
17px base type; hyperlegible face; tabular numerals for all money and quantities.
Phone-first shell: five labeled bottom tabs on mobile, nav pills on desktop.
Saved is always visually distinguishable from pending (green vs. amber).

rules.name: The One Voice Rule
rules.body: Green is the only accent. If a new element wants a hue, it must be expressing money-green confirmation, amber pendingness, or red danger — otherwise it is gray ink on paper. The five chart hues exist solely inside report charts and never leak into UI chrome.

rules.name: The Amber-Means-Pending Rule
rules.body: Amber is never a warm decorative tone. It appears only on money or records that are not yet settled: queued offline writes, reference-lens conversions, low stock.

rules.name: The Tabular Money Rule
rules.body: Every element showing money or comparable quantities carries data-money (or lives in a table) and renders lining-nums tabular-nums. Numbers a user compares sit in a column somewhere.

rules.name: The Both-Currencies Rule
rules.body: Prices print as `$ X · Bs Y` at equal weight — that is how prices are spoken at the counter. Neither currency is the footnote.

rules.name: The 44px Floor Rule
rules.body: No interactive target under 44px. Default controls are 48px (h-12); 40px (h-10/sm) exists only for dense desktop toolbars, never for primary mobile actions.

rules.name: The Ink-Shadow Rule
rules.body: Shadows are always the ink color at low alpha, never neutral black; there are exactly two levels. No hard offset shadows, no glows.

rules.name: The Snapshot Rule
rules.body: PriceTag is only for current prices. Historical and snapshotted rows (sales, finance entries) must print their stored figures via formatMoneyValue — never re-convert past money at today's rate.

rules.name: The Honest Rate Rule
rules.body: While a reference lens is selected, money entry is blocked and lens figures are visibly amber + 'ref.'; only honest-rate money looks settled.

dos: Do print every current price with PriceTag, and every stored/historical figure with formatMoneyValue from its snapshot — the Snapshot Rule is a money-correctness rule, not a style preference.
Do mark every money/quantity element with data-money for tabular numerals.
Do keep default controls at 48px and every target ≥44px; sm sizes are desktop-dense only.
Do display numbers in es-VE format (1.234,56) while accepting dot-decimal keyboard entry.
Do give every primary action a visible text label (Spanish); icons accompany, never replace.
Do use amber exclusively for pending/unsynced/reference states and red exclusively for destructive/out-of-stock.
donts: Don't introduce a second accent hue; the chart palette stays inside charts.
Don't ship icon-only primary actions or sub-44px targets anywhere staff transacts.
Don't re-convert historical money at today's rate, restyle a past row's figures, or show lens-rate money without the amber 'ref.' treatment.
Don't use Anton/Montserrat outside the social-composer canvas; the UI face is Atkinson Hyperlegible Next only.
Don't rely on the .dark token block: it exists but is never toggled — the shipped product is light-only, and new surfaces are designed against the light tokens.
Don't drop below the 17px root or use hard offset shadows, glows, or borderless floating cards.
